reviews.text: A competent and helpful doctor, extremely attentive to our pups' needs. She accompanied me to the Rome/South clinic, giving me so much reassurance and comfort. She has an immeasurable love for her four-legged patients. I highly recommend her.

I highly recommend Dr. Cursia Daria.

Dr. Daria is an excellent professional, humane, and 100% available.
She treats all our four-legged friends as if they were her own, with love, care, and dedication. I dare say that nowadays it's truly difficult to find someone with a heart as big as hers. I will never stop thanking her, thanking her for all the time she dedicated to both me and my little Chicco.
Thank you so much, Doctor ♥️

Dr. Cursio is an extraordinary professional, but above all, an empathetic and sweet person. From the very first visit, she immediately put my Rocky at ease with great calm and patience, without ever making him feel stressed. The love and genuine passion she puts into her work is clearly evident. She explains every step clearly and is always available and reassuring with any questions. I couldn't trust my dog's health to better hands!

For Hope's first visit, I couldn't have asked for a better one... an impeccable doctor! Meticulous, attentive, kind, and lovingly dedicated to her animal friends!
I'm just starting out, and receiving advice, availability, and presence was reassuring! A special thanks to Dr. Cursio 💖

Dr. Daria Cursio is an extraordinary professional and a unique source of inspiration.

I want to share my experience to express my deepest gratitude. To me, my cats Romeo and Zoe are like children; they are my life. After six years of complex treatments and difficult times, I can say with certainty that meeting this professional was our salvation.

Romeo's story:
Romeo has been living with serious heart problems for six years. Unfortunately, due to previous treatments that became too demanding, they ended up seriously compromising his kidneys. I watched Romy deteriorate day after day, until I decided to take the most difficult step: change. I entrusted myself to the doctor and her trusted cardiologist, who immediately adjusted his treatment. The road is still long, but seeing him finally feel more at peace gives me absolute confidence that I'm in the right hands.
Zoe's story:
Zoe is only 4 years old and has been battling growths all over her body for a year, including a large lump and an ulcerated wound above her eye. After undergoing 5 or 7 cytological and histological tests (which fortunately ruled out a tumor, making it unnecessary to continue with repetitive tests), we were at a standstill. The doctor took her situation to heart, and I know she won't give up until she finds a cure and a definitive answer for her.
​Why I highly recommend her:
In six years of managing my little ones' illnesses, I have never met such a special person. She's a veterinarian who texts you on Saturdays to check on your cat, who always answers the phone or calls you back as soon as possible, and who never leaves a message unanswered. This availability and constant presence are something truly unique.
​Beyond her immense medical expertise, the doctor has a heart-warming empathy, love, and tenderness toward animals. My only regret is not having met her sooner. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone who loves their animals!

Finding a good vet is important, but finding one who combines great expertise with unparalleled sensitivity is a rare blessing. The doctor took wonderful care of my dog, treating him as if he were her own. Super professional, helpful, and attentive to every detail. A well-deserved five stars!

A truly exceptional veterinarian: helpful, kind, and very professional. It's immediately clear that she carries out her work with great passion and care for animals. She made us feel at ease, explaining everything clearly and demonstrating great expertise. I absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for a serious, knowledgeable, and above all human professional. Thank you so much for your availability and care!
From Antonio, Franca, and MYA
The doctor is very kind, professional and helpful, always very affectionate with the dog.

Five stars wouldn't be enough to describe the professionalism, kindness, and dedication of my vet... a thousand would be needed.
Over these two years, she has always been there for me and my Sunny, supporting us with care, patience, and love in every single moment, especially the most difficult ones.
She accompanied me every step of the way, never making me feel alone, demonstrating a willingness and humanity that are truly rare today.
For me, she's more than just a vet: she's a point of reference, a special person to whom I would entrust Sunny a thousand times over with my eyes closed.
She's saved him several times, and for that, I will be forever grateful.
Thank you for everything you do, for the passion you put into your work, and for the immense love you give our animals. ❤️
There are not enough words to thank Dr. Cursii Daria who promptly understood my dog's illness and saved her life!!! A special person, professional and animal lover ❤️

5 well-deserved stars. She saved my Luna's life
When my cat had pyometra, I lived a nightmare. The first vet I went to was superficial: surgery performed without tests, the wrong treatment, and zero support when Luna stopped eating and developed complications. I was desperate.

Fortunately, through acquaintances, I reached the doctor. I explained everything over the phone, and her response was immediate: "Bring her to me immediately."
From there, everything changed. She examined Luna with a thoroughness I'd never seen before. She clearly explained the true severity of the infection, without mincing words but with enormous humanity. She designed a customized treatment, choosing palatable medications because she knew Luna wouldn't take them otherwise.
What struck me most? Her presence. She followed up with me day by day, even with texts and phone calls to check on my progress. She explained every possible consequence and every step of the treatment. You could tell she truly cared.
Today, a month later, Luna is doing great. She runs, plays, and is back to her old self. I can say it without a doubt: Dr. Daria was an angel to us. Professional, competent, empathetic, and incredibly helpful.
From now on, she's the only one I have. If you love your animals, trust her with your eyes closed. Thank you so much.

Empathetic, professional, and reliable.
I found the doctor's number by chance while searching for a veterinary clinic open late at night after finding two closed.
She answered even though it was well past 9:00 PM. She was able to figure out the problem even though I was in a panic, and she made herself available all night.
I will definitely trust her with my pets' care.

I've known Dr. Daria Cursio for about six years, ever since I decided to adopt my cat Gioia. She treated her for lung infections, which were rife, and vaccinated her until, with her skill and care, my Gioia was doing great. Over time, due to my move, I had to change vets, and I've NEVER found a veterinarian like her again. In fact, even from a distance, I continue to turn to her. With enormous professionalism, expertise, and empathy (which many vets lack), she always responds to me, giving me crucial advice for my Gioia.
She's exceptional!!! Thank goodness
You're here, Dr. Cursio! Gioia and I adore you ❤️

Dr. Daria Cursio is a guarantee. I switched about a year ago and have had 100% of my beagle's problems resolved. All this is accompanied by excellent preventative care. Daria is someone who loves what she does and shows it every day in her work.

Today, many seem to have forgotten what it means to be a doctor.

Daria Cursio is a rare exception.
She is passionate, has formidable intuition, and demonstrates in every single visit that she leaves nothing to chance.
After 12 years of suffering, my family and I have found the answer to our prayers.
Daria Cursio has never abandoned us, and believe me, you won't understand what I'm talking about unless you see it with your own eyes.
She's not a venal person; she gives in every way possible, even at times when it's not her responsibility, putting the health of our beloved pets first. Practically, always.
She has ALWAYS found a solution to everything. She has often anticipated problems and their consequences (I can assure you that this is simply called SKILL, something foreign to so-called renowned doctors. I speak from experience, unfortunately).
She never tires of listening, she doesn't bullshit people (yes, she treats us like people, not clients), and with great intellectual honesty, she avails herself of the collaboration of professionals who support her when the area isn't within her expertise. In my opinion, this is a gesture of great humility that many of her colleagues unfortunately lack.
With us, she has always been sincere and, above all, CONCRETE.
I've searched extensively for someone who could care for my little ones, often far away, believing that a name or a facility would make the difference, as I read in the comments.
Well, when, unfortunately, after throwing away thousands of euros, my cat Lilyth's days were numbered across the world, Dr. Cursio brought her back to us.
Only love, tenacity, and expertise can make these miracles possible.
And to think, I've always had her 400 meters away.
Sometimes, fortunately, angels are much closer than we think.

Thank you for everything you do for our children, Dr.
Super thorough, empathetic, and caring doctor. Highly recommended 💓 …

Dr. Daria is the doctor everyone would want in their life. Kindness, professionalism and love both towards the little furry patient to be treated and his human "mom" ... In the clinic you can breathe true love for animals
Very attentive and thorough doctor. She gave important advice for the health of my dog ​​Floppy.

The doctor was very kind and professional. She pinpointed the problem and resolved it quickly with excellent results. As tourists in Naples, we trusted her, and she trusted us back. Thank you so much.
Excellent doctor, always available! Truly exceptional.
Excellent doctor who loves her work with four-legged friends

Since I found my little Blue, Dr. Cursio has always been a great help to me with her empathy and total availability. From the first visit, I immediately sensed her great love for animals and for her work. I recommend her to anyone.

After years of going to different vets without finding anyone who could solve my dog ​​Briciola's problems, they finally recommended Dr. Cursio at the Quadrifoglio practice, and from that moment, everything changed!
I've been using her for about five years now, and I couldn't be more satisfied: professional, competent, attentive, and truly passionate about her work. She's succeeded where others couldn't, taking impeccable care of my dog.

Seeing how comfortable I am, I've decided to entrust her with the new addition to the family: a kitten. I know she'll be in excellent hands.
I recommend this vet to anyone who wants the best for their pets. She's truly excellent and deserves all the trust I've placed in her over the years!
